steps.name: Follow Platina to Freios
steps.objective:
1. Follow the person introduced in the 「Elias Royal Palace」 and arrive at the portal to the “Mysterious Forest” in Mirgandia.
2. Follow the person introduced to you and go through “Mysterious Forest 2” to “The Empty Sea”.
3. Cross the “empty sea” and arrive at “Guild Union”.

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text:
Ah, %s! Welcome!
Abama~ The person you’ve been waiting for has arrived!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Oh, %s, I'm glad you look healthy.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: %s. long time no see!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are you Platinum?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It's long, so to speak... Just do it straight and straight! I hope you’ll take a trip to my hometown with me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Platina's hometown... What if?

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: According to her, the Lord came from a different continent than Giendia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … … … Another continent?!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: That's right. The name of the continent I lived on was [Preyos].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Prayos… !

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: %s, you must go to Freios with Platina and check out the world she lives in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I would like to ask you a few questions.

choices.text: 1. Why are you asking me this?

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: It is said that the portal that has now appeared in Midgard was created by accident.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: As for me, I wanted to entrust the mission to the commander of the guard, Sir Levi Ahrens, but... According to the reports of the court wizards, the portal that appeared in Midgard is very unstable and is very dangerous for Ziendians to use.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: %s They say it's not a big problem for Adventurer people like you who come from other worlds.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Also, it seems that Lord Platina also has some business for you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ???? (Platina to me?)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Did you get that feeling from what I said? It's a sharp feeling... .

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: The name Freios is not unfamiliar. The name is clearly stated in the history books. We find the names of Prayos, Othros, and other continents.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: However, for a long time, we, the people of Giendia, have lived forgetting the existence of other continents.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Jim was wondering if it was simply because the other continents were too far away for trade... . Actually, there may have been another reason.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: I intend to resolve this question through your travels. Be sure not to neglect everything you see and hear in the new land.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Purpose… ? Ahaha… … . Don't look at me with such suspicious eyes.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I knew it the moment I met %s. A mission to guide %s to a world that %s has not yet encountered.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I have a special intuition as a [Holy Orderer].

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: One day, he went on a journey according to the oracle of the [Blue Dragon], but was caught up in a storm and arrived at this place, the legendary continent of Gyendia... And Zenadia.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: And then I met you. The purpose of my trip this time is probably [you].

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: This meeting is meant to lead you to a new world.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: And this small journey will have great meaning as it becomes a huge wave in the future.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Maybe… To the whole world... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The world? It’s a story so large in scale that I can’t even imagine….)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Well, no need to take it too seriously!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: People just need to do their best in the short time given to them!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Wouldn’t you like to enjoy a short and exciting trip with the beautiful girl paladin Platinum♡? >_<

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … … … … … … … … … (Do you usually say it with your own mouth?)

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: (Excited! I wish. I want to go too~)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: (Perhaps because she is the daughter of a foreign country, she looks cheerful and outwardly! If I were 10 years younger, I would have gone on an adventure... but it's a shame.)

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Good. Then go to Midgard. In the center of the city, there will be a portal of a type you have never seen before.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Take a close look at what the world beyond the portal is like and let Jim know.

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: May good luck and blessings be with you in all the adventures that await you!

lines.speaker: 헤종
lines.text: Sir Platina, although our meeting was short, it was very enjoyable. I hope you visit again.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. I also had a lot of fun.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Princess Herne also came to see me. How are you?

lines.speaker: 헤르네
lines.text: Ugh, yeah… Platinum unni too... I definitely have to let you hear it again! Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...You seem to have become very close to your sister.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Then %s, let’s go to a city called Midgard! Please guide me!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It's this portal. I can feel the wildly swirling magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure… It looks quite dangerous. Mr. Platina, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You don't have to worry about me. Even though it looks like this, it's still healthy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um… all right. then… Here we go!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Wow, I’m dizzy!… %s, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's okay. ah… This place… .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hmm... this is my first time seeing a forest, hmm, where did I fall... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh my, have I become a lost child? Eh... . Well, let's walk first.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Of course! Hehe, you're not nervous at all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because this kind of thing is familiar. furthermore…

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Huh? furthermore?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The air is so refreshing... . I have a good feeling.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hey! Look at the sky!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … !! Countless chunks of land are floating in the sky... ?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: That's my hometown, Freios!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Prayos… This is no ordinary continent. I was surprised.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hehe… I was surprised. It's kind of fun.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It is said that in the past, Preios, like Giendia, was an ordinary land that was immersed in the sea. No, Gndia is by no means an ‘ordinary’ place, but... Anyway.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: However, it is said that in the [Age of Myth], in the aftermath of the great battle between light and darkness, it was shattered into pieces and took on that form.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I don't know much about the detailed history... Please take your time and investigate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. So what is this land that we are currently stepping on? I don't think it's Gendia... Is it another continent?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Um… I think this is an area called [Mirgandia].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mirgandia…

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It is the only land remaining above ground among the land mass of Freios. I understand that the [Gate] that leads to this area is a land that has been lost for a long time and is no longer visited by people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh... doesn't that get you in a bit of trouble?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Well, it will work out somehow, right? You said earlier that you had a good feeling, right? I am like that too. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um… I feel encouraged to hear that Platina is like that too. So let’s move on!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes! Let’s go~~~~

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Phew, glad I found a working gate. hmm… . good! This is an area I know well!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you found your way. But what is this big portal we just went through? And here?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ah, this is called [Imperial Gate]. This place is called the [Void Sea], a sky sea full of magical power!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: As you can see, Freios is a continent made up of numerous sky islands floating in the [empty sea].

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: So the [old empire] built gates like that all over the world. Even areas that are very far away can be reached in an instant through this gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it different from an ordinary portal?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Umm… . I'm not an intelligent person, so if you ask me more than that, I get this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow! What a surprise!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: There are a lot of wizards where you will go from now on, so if you ask them, they will tell you well.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Well, you've finally arrived. This is the headquarters of the Guild Alliance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Guild union… ?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: This is the perfect city to start your adventure in Freios. Now, it's time to part ways for a moment. %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Mr. Platinum? Where are you going?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: (…if we don’t break up now, they’ll find out about %s’s existence. I can’t let %s be in danger now…!)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Now that I'm back after a long time, I think I need to do some of the things I've been putting off. Ah, I'm lazy so I always have a lot of work to do!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… . Oh, that's a shame. It would be fun to travel together!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I feel sorry too. I'm really curious about what %s will see and do in the future.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: But I have a feeling that we will meet again soon, so for now, we will smile and part ways. Hello, %s! cheer up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Platinum too! hi!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Bye bye!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (……Platina is gone. I am alone in this unfamiliar place. It feels like the first time I came to La Tale World.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (From now on, you'll have to face it alone. Come on, cheer up and let's go!)
